text:
mel: Quick demo prep catch 3 small UI nits in Security > Data settings. Can we tidy before next release?

jina: Yep, list them out.

mel: 1) Chip order: header shows [region] [encryption]. People read encryption as a region attribute. Suggest move encryption chip left of region or separate it visually with label: `Encryption: Customer key (BYOK)` / `Encryption: Redwood key`.

pax: 2) Short vs full copy: keep visible label short for narrow screens (e.g. `Customer key (BYOK)`), and put the full phrasing in tooltip and aria-label.

mel: 3) Screen reader: currently reads "chip, button". Use aria-label="Encryption: customer-managed key (BYOK). Press for details." Add aria-describedby pointing to a hidden explanation node about ownership vs storage.

pax: 4) Focus ring: keyboard outline is faint. Recommend 2px solid focus color (#0057D9) or system focus token to meet contrast. Also fix tab order so chip is reached before tooltip action.

jina: 5) Region fallback badge is ambiguous. Change to `Region: EU (fallback)` and tooltip: "Data stored in fallback region due to capacity; retention defaults may differ." Keep tooltip short for i18n.

mel: 6) Audit CSV exports: current verbing is terse (KEY_ROTATE). Propose headers `event_time_utc,event,user_email,details` and rows like `2024-11-02T14:32:00Z,Key rotated,admin@example.com,Customer key rotated to v3` so exports are readable and timezone-explicit.

a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: ensure chip has role=button, tabindex=0, visible focus, aria-pressed if toggling. Audit table needs role=row/role=cell and aria-sort on sortable headers.

pax: I'll sketch two placement options in Figma and open a tiny PR for the focus ring + aria updates.

mel: Thanks. Can someone also update the Data residency docs screenshot after copy lands so docs match the UI?

jina: I'll handle the screenshot once PR merges.

a11y-bot: Created ticket UX-1214: "encryption chip clarity + a11y + audit export" (labels: ux, accessibility, compliance).
